biology: simulated Izhikevich culture only; no living neural tissue

metrics.method: supervised random-Fourier-feature ridge ensemble on synthetic IK transitions
metrics.model_role: one-step forward dynamics predictor; not a controller or generative model

open_loop.note: Actions are from the held-out IK trajectory; this is a model test, not a policy rollout.

metrics.uncertainty_note: Ensemble disagreement and nearest standardized training distance are diagnostics, not calibrated confidence.

limitations: state-based single-arm reaching only; no tissue contact, instruments, or camera simulation
bias/noise/action-gain ranges are procedural stress assumptions, not measured clinical distributions
DLSIK is a geometry-aware reference and uses the simulator Jacobian
three episodes per family are robustness checks, not precise success estimates
